### All Things Are Possible in God
Author: Michael A. Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-january-28-2026.html
Passage: Numbers 13:1-2
Points:
- People respond differently when facing change, ranging from visionary believers to skeptics demanding proof.
- God commanded Moses to send tribal leaders to explore the land He had already promised to give them.
- Even though the scouts found great abundance in the land, fear of obstacles caused most of them to doubt.
- Believers are called to trust God's sovereignty and faithfulness rather than needing guaranteed success before obeying.
